profile.name: Cloud-Native STAC and GeoParquet Agent
profile.description: Searches Cloud-Native SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs (STAC) across Element84 Earth Search and Microsoft Planetary Computer (`sentinel-2-l2a`, `landsat-c2-l2`, `cop-dem-glo-30`, `naip`) and filters GeoParquet/vector spatial datasets by bounding box, cloud cover, and datetime range.

provider.name: Geoinformation and Big Data Research Lab (GIBD)

skills.name: Search STAC Satellite Catalog
skills.description: Queries Element84 Earth Search or Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC endpoints by collection, bounding box, datetime interval, and cloud-cover threshold, exporting scene footprints and COG asset links as GeoJSON, GeoPackage, Parquet, or CSV.

constraints.spatial: Global coverage across Sentinel-2, Landsat Collection 2, and Copernicus 30m DEM.
other: No API key is required for STAC catalog queries.
Supports GeoJSON, GeoPackage, Parquet, and CSV outputs.

skills.name: Filter Cloud-Native GeoParquet and Vector Datasets
skills.description: Reads GeoParquet, GeoJSON, or GeoPackage input datasets, normalizes CRS to EPSG:4326, extracts bounding-box summaries, and generates static PNG footprint maps and HTML reports.

other: Supports local or URL-delivered GeoParquet, GeoJSON, and GeoPackage files.

execute_task.name: ExecuteTask
execute_task.description: Submits a natural-language STAC catalog search or GeoParquet filtering task to the agent. Supports sync, async, and stream execution modes.

instructions.description: Natural-language instructions such as 'Search Sentinel-2 L2A scenes over State College with less than 20% cloud cover and export GeoParquet.'

input_datasets.description: Optional GeoParquet, GeoJSON, or GeoPackage datasets to filter and summarize.

artifact_delivery.description: How generated artifacts are delivered in the standard response: 'URL' (default) or 'Encoded'.

primary_artifacts.description: STAC scene footprints or filtered spatial features with scene metadata and COG asset URLs.
Static PNG footprint map colored by cloud cover or scene coverage.
HTML summary report listing scene IDs, acquisition dates, cloud cover, and asset counts.

model.description: Optional model override used when LLM-assisted planning is enabled.

collection.description: STAC collection ID such as sentinel-2-l2a, landsat-c2-l2, or cop-dem-glo-30.

bbox.description: Bounding box [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] in WGS84 degrees.

credentials.description: No API key is required for deterministic STAC catalog queries and GeoParquet processing.

provenance.description: Records STAC catalog endpoint, collection, bounding box, datetime interval, tool-call trace, and output artifact count.

reproducibility.description: Returns deterministic STAC query parameters, bounding boxes, and environment metadata in the standard GAS response.

validation.description: Validates that returned STAC footprints or GeoParquet features form a valid EPSG:4326 GeoDataFrame.

access_control.description: Allowed roles set to ['all'] via the extension profile. No role-based access control is enforced.

operation_policy.description: Uses deterministic STAC API queries and GeoPandas/PyArrow serialization without arbitrary code execution.

governance.policy_notes: Scene footprints reflect STAC catalog metadata at query time.

extensions.description: Supports cloud-native STAC discovery across Element84 Earth Search and Microsoft Planetary Computer with GeoJSON, GeoPackage, GeoParquet, CSV, PNG footprint map, and HTML report generation.

data_sources.name: Element84 Earth Search STAC API
data_sources.description: Public STAC API for Sentinel-2 L2A, Copernicus DEM, Landsat, and NAIP Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API
data_sources.description: Global STAC catalog for environmental and satellite Earth observation datasets.
